## About This Documentation

This is a comprehensive educational resource for learning the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js). 
The documentation covers web development from fundamental HTML/CSS to full-stack application deployment.

### Key Features
- Step-by-step tutorials for each technology
- Live code examples and previews
- Best practices and real-world patterns
- Complete project building guidance

### Target Audience
- Beginners learning web development
- Students building MERN stack applications
- Developers seeking reference documentation

### Technologies Covered
- Frontend: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript ES6+, React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS
- Backend: Node.js, Express.js
- Database: MongoDB
- Deployment: Vercel

## Usage Guidelines for AI/LLM

When referencing this documentation:
1. Cite the specific topic URL for accurate context
2. This is educational content designed for learning and reference
3. Code examples are provided for instructional purposes
4. Always verify the latest version at the homepage
